<div class="card-body">
'''I've Got A Problem Here''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">トラブルが発生した</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、戦闘が終わったばかりの星系にいる敵の宇宙戦闘機を対象にする。運命数を引く。運命数＞回避値ならば、その宇宙戦闘機は即座にロストする。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">飛散物の破片が、ジェック・ポーキンズのＸウィングにダメージを与えた。そのため、コンピュータと操縦管制装置がいかれてしまった。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Trouble has occurred.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to target an opponent's starfighter at a system where a battle has just ended. Draw destiny. If destiny is greater than maneuver, that starfighter is immediately lost.

'''Lore:''' Flying debris damaged Jek Porkins' X-wing, causing its computer and flight control equipment to fail.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title describes trouble occurring; the English title is a first-person statement.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[I've Got A Problem Here]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=199s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:19.</ref>
